name: detain/phlix-shared
description: Shared interfaces, DTOs, event names, and protocol types used by both phlix-server and phlix-hub. Composer-installable, PHP 8.3+, zero I/O by charter — bundled I/O is confined to the Arr/ namespace: the blocking CurlArrTransport default (CLI/test posture) and TrashGuidesProvider's own blocking stream fetches (no transport seam there); event-loop consumers should inject an async ArrTransportInterface unless their runtime hooks curl (phlix-hub's S425 position).

suggest.ext-curl: Required only for the bundled blocking Arr\Transport\CurlArrTransport (CLI/test use). Event-loop (Workerman/Webman) consumers should inject an async ArrTransportInterface instead and do not need ext-curl.
suggest.workerman/http-client: Event-loop (Workerman/Webman) consumers should inject a workerman/http-client-backed Arr\Transport\ArrTransportInterface so *arr API calls do not block the worker; the bundled CurlArrTransport is blocking and for CLI/test only.
